name: University of Helsinki
summary: University of Helsinki: two English bachelor's, Science at Kumpula and Liberal Arts across three campuses; IB holders apply in March, not January.

ib.text: IB Diploma holders must apply in admission group 2 and are ranked on their IB grades. An IB taken in English proves your English; otherwise English A at grade 2 or English A2 at grade 5.

dates.label: Admission group 2 (IB Diploma holders) opens, 08:00 Finnish time
Admission group 2 (IB Diploma holders) closes, 15:00 Finnish time

programmes.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
programmes.credential: BA, BSc or Bachelor of Social Sciences
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary degree joining natural sciences, social sciences and humanities to train analysis, problem-solving and critical thinking; it leads on to more than a dozen Helsinki master's programmes.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published (due by end of October 2026). IB holders apply in admission group 2 (9–23 March 2027) and are ranked on IB grades.

programmes.name: Science
programmes.about: Maths and statistics, physics, chemistry, and computer and data science in one programme, from fundamental research to practical applications, at the Kumpula science campus.
programmes.selectionNote: 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published (due by end of October 2026). IB holders apply in admission group 2 in March and are ranked on IB grades.

notes: The January round (group 1, 5–19 January 2027) is only for applicants without an IB, EB or Finnish matriculation diploma, so as an IB student you cannot use it.
Helsinki's March round is separate from the national January joint application, so you can apply to both.
Helsinki will publish its 2027 admission criteria, including IB document deadlines, by the end of October 2026.
